verbalization: Jerantinine A is implicated in the regulation of Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1 through a series of molecular interactions. The evidence suggests that Jerantinine A acts as a target of multiple compounds, including Bicyclo[7.2.0]undec-3-en-5-ol, 4,11,11-trimethyl-8-methylene-, (1R,3Z,5S,9S)-rel- and Isopropyl caprate, all of which are known to target the DNMT3A2/3L complex. This complex, in turn, is the target of 3-Hydroxymollugin, which ultimately leads to the activation of Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1. The integration of these pathways highlights a potential mechanism by which Jerantinine A may influence the transporter, possibly through the modulation of DNMT3A2/3L complex activity. The evidence supports a direct or indirect relationship between Jerantinine A and the transporter, with the DNMT3A2/3L complex serving as a critical mediator in this interaction.
